summary.title: Changes Overview
summary.info: Click 'Detail' in the toolbar to see detailed changes per phase, or 'Commit' to create a Git commit.

repo.needsAttributes: The audit repository does not enforce canonical .tara.json handling (LF/text). Set .gitattributes to avoid unnecessary diff noise.
repo.notARepo: This project file is not inside a Git repository.
repo.needsHooks: The audit repo has no local commit-message hook. Install it to catch malformed audit commits early — including from the command line.

config.title: Audit Configuration
config.patInfo: Personal Access Token will be securely stored in your system keychain.
config.patHelp: Enter your PAT with 'repo' permissions. Leave empty to keep existing token.
config.sshInfo: SSH authentication uses your system's SSH keys (~/.ssh/id_rsa or ~/.ssh/id_ed25519).
config.sshKeyPathHelp: Leave empty to use default SSH key
config.gpgInfo: GPG signing ensures your commits are cryptographically verified. Your private key will be securely stored.
config.gpgKeyIdHelp: Enter the last 8 characters of your GPG key ID
config.gpgPrivateKeyHelp: Paste your armored private key. Leave empty to keep existing key or generate new one.

signers.title: Authorized signers
signers.help: Keys allowed to sign audit commits (.tara/allowed_signers). Adding or removing one is itself a signed audit: commit.
signers.noRepo: Open a project inside its audit repo to manage signers.
signers.principalHelp: The commit-author email of the signer — must match how they commit.
signers.maintainerAdd: Grant maintainer role (may change the manifest)
signers.noMaintainer: This manifest has no maintainer — no one can change it. Promote a signer to maintainer.

warnings.notConfigured: Git configuration incomplete. Please configure Git settings before committing.

protection.noRepo: Open a project inside its audit repo to see protection status.
protection.noTrail: No audit trail yet — the checklist appears once the signer manifest is committed.
protection.allGood: All locally verifiable checks pass. Complete the host settings below to prevent history rewrites.
protection.someFail: Some locally verifiable checks failed — see below.
protection.dontAutoShow: Don't warn me at commit time for this repository
protection.hostNote: Host settings can't be verified locally — this is guidance, not a live status check.

verify.title: Audit trail verification
verify.subtitle: Reconstructs the signing authority from the committed history and reports any commit that isn't authorized by the manifest as it stood before it.
verify.noAnchor: No audit anchor yet — add a signer manifest (Signers tab) first.
verify.lead: Check that every change in the trail is signed and in order.
verify.passBody: Every change is signed and in order.
verify.failBody: Some checks did not pass — see the details below.

ANCHOR_NOT_FOUND.title: No signer manifest in the history
ANCHOR_NOT_FOUND.hint: Bootstrap the trail: add a signer on the Signers tab — that creates the manifest and its first commit.

ANCHOR_MISMATCH.title: The trail starts from a different root than expected
ANCHOR_MISMATCH.hint: The pinned anchor doesn't match this history. Re-pin it to this repo's bootstrap commit, or check you're on the right branch.

ANCHOR_TAG_MOVED.title: The audit-root tag points somewhere else
ANCHOR_TAG_MOVED.hint: Move the audit-root tag onto the bootstrap commit — or ignore this if the tag is intentionally elsewhere.

ANCHOR_SIGNER_NOT_MAINTAINER.title: The first signer isn't a maintainer
ANCHOR_SIGNER_NOT_MAINTAINER.hint: The bootstrap commit must be signed by someone listed as a maintainer in the manifest it introduces.

PRE_ANCHOR_COMMITS.title: Some commits come before the audit start
PRE_ANCHOR_COMMITS.hint: These predate the trail and aren't verified — expected right after bootstrapping an existing project.

SIG_UNSIGNED.title: A commit isn't signed
SIG_UNSIGNED.hint: Enable commit signing in the audit config and re-commit — unsigned commits can't be attributed to a signer.

SIG_BAD.title: A signature isn't valid
SIG_BAD.hint: The signature couldn't be verified against the signer's key. Re-sign the commit with a valid key.

SIGNER_NOT_AUTHORIZED.title: A commit was signed by someone not yet authorized
SIGNER_NOT_AUTHORIZED.hint: The signer wasn't in the manifest before this commit. A maintainer must add them before they sign.

MANIFEST_NOT_MAINTAINER.title: A manifest change wasn't made by a maintainer
MANIFEST_NOT_MAINTAINER.hint: Only maintainers may change .tara/allowed_signers. Have a maintainer make the change.

MANIFEST_NO_MAINTAINER.title: The signer manifest has no maintainer
MANIFEST_NO_MAINTAINER.hint: Add at least one maintainer on the Signers tab, otherwise the manifest can never be changed again.

MANIFEST_EMPTY.title: The signer manifest is empty
MANIFEST_EMPTY.hint: Add a signer on the Signers tab.

MSG_SCHEMA.title: A commit message doesn't follow the required format
MSG_SCHEMA.hint: Use '[TARA] <round>' with the required trailers, or 'audit:' for infra commits. The managed hook enforces this going forward.

REVIEW_MISSING.title: A change is missing a reviewer
REVIEW_MISSING.hint: Add a 'Reviewed-by' trailer naming a second person when four-eyes review is required.

REVIEW_SELF.title: The author reviewed their own change
REVIEW_SELF.hint: The reviewer must be a different person than the author.

HISTORY_NONLINEAR.title: The history isn't linear
HISTORY_NONLINEAR.hint: An unexpected merge or rewrite was found. Keep the audit branch linear (fast-forward only).

HISTORY_ORPHAN.title: A commit has no path back to the start
HISTORY_ORPHAN.hint: A commit doesn't trace back to the anchor — a sign of a rewrite. Investigate the history.

REPO_DIRTY.title: There are uncommitted changes
REPO_DIRTY.hint: Commit or discard the working-tree changes, then verify again.

REPO_DETACHED_HEAD.title: You're not on a branch (detached HEAD)
REPO_DETACHED_HEAD.hint: Check out the audit branch before verifying.

TCS_NONREPRODUCIBLE.title: A project file isn't in canonical form
TCS_NONREPRODUCIBLE.hint: Re-save the .tara.json with the current app so it matches the canonical (reproducible) format.

TCS_PARSE_ERROR.title: A project file couldn't be read
TCS_PARSE_ERROR.hint: A .tara.json is corrupt or truncated. Restore it from git history.

TCS_UNKNOWN_VERSION.title: A project file uses a newer format
TCS_UNKNOWN_VERSION.hint: This file records a TCS version this build doesn't know — update the app.

HOOKS_VERSION_MISMATCH.title: The installed git hooks are outdated
HOOKS_VERSION_MISMATCH.hint: Re-install the managed hooks (Install git hooks) to get the current version.

HOOKS_MISSING.title: The git hooks aren't installed
HOOKS_MISSING.hint: Install the managed hooks to guard commits locally (the CLI/CI check stays authoritative).

PROTECTION_ATTESTATION.title: Branch protection is recorded, not checked here
PROTECTION_ATTESTATION.hint: Confirm branch protection on your git host — it can't be observed from the local repo.

ROUND_NONMONOTONIC.title: Round numbers aren't increasing
ROUND_NONMONOTONIC.hint: Informational — rounds are repeatable workflow phases, not a counter.

ENGINE_ERROR.title: A check couldn't complete
ENGINE_ERROR.hint: One check failed to run; the technical message has details. The rest of the result is still valid.
